author: Axiom IV
title: Mixture of Backbones: Gumbel Gate on Two DSConv Dilation Paths
abstract: This is a final attempt to innovate on the SOTA backbone, correcting for previous implementation failures. My reflection suggested the fixed dilation pattern of the DSConv block is a key weakness. This experiment tests that insight by creating a Mixture-of-Experts that operates on the backbones themselves. The model uses a Gumbel-Softmax gate to choose between two parallel DSConv backbones, each with a different dilation schedule. The selected feature map is then passed to a single, simple mean+max pooling head. This directly tests if learning to select a dilation pattern on a per-sample basis can outperform the SOTA's fixed backbone.
